note.question: How can probabilistic topic model for hybrid recommender systems be addressed using a stochastic variational bayesian approach?
note.overview: This paper proposes a novel covariate-guided heterogeneous supervised topic model for online movie recommendation and develops a stochastic variational Bayesian framework to achieve fast, scalable, and accurate estimation in big data settings.
